# Bundled Dependencies

These pinned browser builds are served locally and cached with the application.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PDF.js | 3.11.174 | https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js | Apache-2.0 |
| html2canvas | 1.4.1 | https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas | MIT |
| jsPDF | 4.2.1 | https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF | MIT |
| Lucide | 0.468.0 | https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide | ISC / MIT |

The corresponding license texts are included in this directory. PDF.js retains
the version used by the existing application; its main build and worker must be
updated together.
